_comment: Token-based Cloudflare Tunnel egg for Pterodactyl.
name: Cloudflare Tunnel (Token)
author: github@robohelo.xyz
description: Runs cloudflared with a remotely-managed tunnel token from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard. No interactive login, no cert.pem, no config.yml. Public hostnames and target services are configured in the Cloudflare dashboard.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64)  ARCH="amd64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${CFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${CFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-${ARCH}"
else
  URL="https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/download/${CFT_VERSION}/cloudflared-linux-${ARCH}"
fi

echo "Downloading cloudflared from ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o cloudflared.new "${URL}"
chmod +x cloudflared.new
mv -f cloudflared.new cloudflared

./cloudflared --version
echo "Install finished. Paste your tunnel token into the Startup tab, then start the server."

variables.name: Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token of a remotely-managed tunnel (starts with eyJ). Get it in Cloudflare Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels > your tunnel > Configure. Keep it secret.

variables.name: Transport Protocol
variables.description: auto lets cloudflared choose. Use http2 if UDP/QUIC is blocked on your network.

variables.name: cloudflared Version
variables.description: Release tag to install (e.g. 2025.10.0) or latest. Only applied on install or reinstall.
